# bit-context v0.2.1

This release makes boolean gate state easier to inspect and strengthens the Codex skill's resume workflow.

## Highlights

- `bitctx eval --format text` now renders a fixed 8×8 matrix covering all 64 bit positions.
- Matrix cells use `O` for satisfied selected conditions, `X` for unsatisfied selected conditions, and `·` for positions outside the selected mask.
- `--show all`, `--show satisfied`, and `--show missing` add ordered condition details when needed.
- The compatibility wrapper forwards the new detail filter.
- The Codex skill more explicitly resumes from persisted checkpoints and avoids replaying settled procedures.

## Compatibility

- JSON remains the default evaluation format and its structure is unchanged.
- Existing v0.1 and v0.2 schemas and sessions remain readable.
- An `X` means unsatisfied; it does not assert a verified negative.
- Release binaries remain available for Linux and macOS on x86-64 and ARM64.
